town_chain — DRIVE town op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.town_chain(elements, *, start=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), overlap: 'float' = 0.05) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetown; drivetown.town_chain(elements, *, start=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), overlap: 'float' = 0.05) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("town_chain"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Places the elements by chaining them in order: solves in closed form the rigid placement that aligns the entry of element k+1 with the exit of element k (overlap before it) and passes it to drivecourse.course_layout.

Parameters

elements : sequence of drivecourse elements (dicts). Joined in order.

start : world pose (x, y, yaw) at which the entry of the first element is placed.

overlap : overlap at the joints [m] (≥ 0, so that no kerb stands at the joints when made 3-D). From the second element on, the overlap must not exceed that element's centreline.

Returns

dict : the course_layout dict with "chain" added. chain = {"overlap", "s_start" (n,) 各要素の entry の弧長, "lengths" (n,) 各要素の centerline_length, "polyline_lengths" (n,) 中心線の折線長, "total_length" (= Σ 折線長 − overlap × (n − 1)), "joints": [(exit_k, entry_k+1), ...] 世界姿勢}.

Raises ValueError: elements empty / nested layout / missing entry/exit/centerline, start/overlap non-finite, overlap negative, overlap longer than an element centreline.
